reason: The only offered action uses the auger at the ice, which seems like the first step toward supplying the water processor.
expectation: I expect it to extract ice or water that can be moved to the processor, though I don't know the exact result.

effect: The well produces cloudy water that still needs treatment, so connecting it for transport is the next step.
reaction: The heated probe producing a trickle makes the extraction process clear.
reason: The hose seems suited to carrying water from the well toward the processor, and this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the hose to connect to the well, possibly preparing a route to the processor; I'm unsure whether it will connect both ends at once.

effect: The hose connected both the well and processor, completing the transport goal; treatment and drinking-water checks still lie ahead.
reaction: The raw-water strainer catching grit gives a clear sense of why the water needs treatment.
reason: Processing the connected water line is the only offered combination and directly serves the remaining potable-water goal.
expectation: I expect the processor to treat the well water, though I don't know whether checking it will require another step.

effect: The processor treated and checked the water, completing the potable supply and the chapter.
reaction: The nearly tasteless first cup is a satisfying result from the dusty ice bank.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making drinking water was most worthwhile because it connected the extraction process to a usable supply and explained the treatment stages.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hose felt least engaging as a decision because it was the only offered combination, though the strainer detail was useful.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the heated probe produced liquid water at the well, and that the hose connected all the way to the processor in one action.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each followed the path from extracting water to treating it, although every step had only one offered combination.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the expedition develops and learn more about its systems, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
